title: Is there an optimal duration for a Speech Therapy session for a child with Autism?
metaTitle: Understanding Speech Therapy Duration for Autism | Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Learn how Pinnacle Blooms Network sets Speech Therapy session lengths considering each child's unique needs and attention span.
html: At Pinnacle Blooms Network, we believe in creating therapy regimes that are both impactful and comfortable for our amazing children. Each individual child's therapy duration is dynamically set to suit their unique needs, attention span, and developmental strengths. Typically, sessions can range from 30 minutes to an hour, with adequate breaks. Our caring therapists maintain flexible and adaptive, always prioritising the individual child's comfort and well-being in each session.
